name: Forecasted Earnings
plain_description: A traceable earnings forecast built from confirmed historical figures and visible assumptions.

sections.name: Basis and Assumptions
sections.description: Forecast period, baseline, scenarios and confirmed drivers.

sections.name: Revenue and Cost Forecast
sections.description: Formula-derived revenue and cost projections by period.

sections.name: Earnings and Scenarios
sections.description: Gross profit, EBITDA and net earnings where source data supports them.

sections.name: Risks and Limitations
sections.description: Material sensitivities, unknowns and source limitations.

missing_detail_rules.reason: Forecast values require a defined period and granularity.
Financial values cannot be interpreted without a currency.
The source baseline distinguishes evidence from assumptions.

recommendation_reason: Use this when the user needs defensible future earnings projections rather than a historical P&L.

name: EBITDA Analysis
plain_description: A source-traceable EBITDA reconciliation with clearly labelled adjustments and limitations.

sections.name: Source Operating Result
sections.description: The confirmed starting result and accounting basis.

sections.name: EBITDA Reconciliation
sections.description: Interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation reconciliation.

sections.name: Adjustments
sections.description: Each proposed normalising adjustment with evidence and rationale.

sections.name: Interpretation and Limitations
sections.description: Margins, comparisons and limits of the analysis.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The calculation must be anchored to a reporting period.
The calculation requires a stated currency.
Reported and adjusted EBITDA depend on the agreed definition.

recommendation_reason: Use this to reconcile EBITDA from an uploaded P&L or trial balance without confusing it with cash flow or statutory profit.

name: Investment Capital Gains Report
plain_description: A traceable review of investment disposals, cost bases and realised gains or losses.

sections.name: Source Coverage
sections.description: Owner, jurisdiction, period, supplied records and missing evidence.

sections.name: Holdings and Disposals
sections.description: Itemised acquisition and disposal records.

sections.name: Gain and Loss Calculations
sections.description: Traceable proceeds, cost base and gain or loss calculations.

sections.name: Summary and Review Warning
sections.description: Bounded summary, assumptions and professional-review warning.

missing_detail_rules.reason: Ownership determines which records belong in the report.
Capital gains treatment depends on jurisdiction and period.
A parcel method is required to pair acquisitions and disposals.

recommendation_reason: Use this for evidence-led investment gain and loss review, not as an invented tax return or liability calculation.

name: Quote / Estimate
plain_description: An itemised quote or estimate with confirmed pricing, scope, validity and acceptance terms.

sections.name: Supplier and Customer
sections.description: Confirmed supplier, customer and quote identifiers.

sections.name: Scope and Itemised Pricing
sections.description: Scope, quantities, rates, tax and reconciled totals.
vital: Quantity and rate for each item

sections.name: Terms and Acceptance
sections.description: Validity, exclusions, variations, payment and acceptance.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The issuing supplier must be identified.
The intended customer must be identified.
A quote cannot be final without confirmed scope and prices.

recommendation_reason: Use this to present confirmed commercial scope and pricing for customer acceptance.

name: Invoice
plain_description: An itemised invoice with deterministic subtotal, tax and total calculations.

sections.name: Invoice Details
sections.description: Supplier, customer, identifiers, issue date and due date.

sections.name: Supplied Items
sections.description: Confirmed items, quantities, unit prices and tax treatment.

sections.name: Totals and Payment
sections.description: Reconciled totals, payment terms and confirmed payment details.

fields.name: invoice_details
fields.label: Invoice number, dates and itemised supplies

missing_detail_rules.reason: The supplier must be identified.
The customer must be identified.
An invoice requires confirmed identifiers, dates and supplied items.

recommendation_reason: Use this after goods or services have been supplied and payment is requested.

name: Purchase Order
plain_description: A controlled purchase order recording requested items, agreed prices, delivery and approval.

sections.name: Order and Parties
sections.description: Buyer, supplier, PO number, approval and delivery details.

sections.name: Items and Totals
sections.description: Requested items, quantities, prices, tax and totals.

sections.name: Terms and Revision
sections.description: Order terms and revision history without implying acceptance.

fields.name: order_details
fields.label: PO number, delivery and itemised order

missing_detail_rules.reason: The purchasing entity must be identified.
The intended supplier must be identified.
The order requires confirmed identifiers, delivery and items.

recommendation_reason: Use this to authorise and record a purchase request without implying supplier acceptance.

name: Cash Flow Forecast
plain_description: A period-by-period cash forecast showing confirmed assumptions, closing cash and low-cash risks.

sections.name: Opening Cash and Assumptions
sections.description: Opening balance, horizon, granularity and scenario assumptions.

sections.name: Inflows and Outflows
sections.description: Timed cash movements by confirmed category.

sections.name: Closing Cash and Scenarios
sections.description: Deterministic closing balances and low-cash periods.

fields.name: cash_movements
fields.label: Expected inflows and outflows with timing

missing_detail_rules.reason: Closing cash cannot be calculated without opening cash.
Cash timing requires a defined forecast period.
The forecast requires confirmed inflow and outflow assumptions.

recommendation_reason: Use this to assess future liquidity separately from accounting profit.

name: Expense Claim / Reimbursement Report
plain_description: An evidenced, itemised expense claim with duplicate and approval controls.

sections.name: Claim Details
sections.description: Claimant, organisation, project and claim period.

sections.name: Itemised Expenses
sections.description: Date, category, purpose, amount, currency, tax and receipt evidence.

sections.name: Totals and Approval
sections.description: Reconciled totals, declaration and approval state.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The claimant must be identified.
The claim needs a defined period.
Reimbursement requires itemised confirmed expenses.

recommendation_reason: Use this to submit evidenced business expenses for review without deciding policy eligibility.

name: Project Plan
plain_description: A practical project plan connecting objectives, deliverables, owners, milestones, risks and success measures.

sections.name: Objective, Governance and Scope
sections.description: Sponsor, objective, scope, constraints and success measures.

sections.name: Deliverables and Schedule
sections.description: Deliverables, tasks, owners, milestones and dependencies.

sections.name: Risks and Communications
sections.description: Risks, controls, communications and review cadence.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The plan must have a confirmed objective and scope.
A project plan requires defined outputs and timing.
Accountability requires confirmed ownership.

recommendation_reason: Use this to turn a confirmed project goal into governed delivery work.

name: Project Status Report
plain_description: A reporting-period update comparing confirmed progress with the approved project baseline.

sections.name: Executive Status
sections.description: Period, scope and evidence-based overall status.

sections.name: Progress and Milestones
sections.description: Completed, upcoming and delayed work against plan.

sections.name: Risks, Issues and Decisions
sections.description: Current risks, issues, decisions and support required.

missing_detail_rules.reason: Status must be tied to a reporting period.
Progress cannot be assessed without baseline and actuals.
Material risks and issues must be disclosed.

recommendation_reason: Use this for an evidence-backed project update without inventing progress or status.

name: Meeting Agenda
plain_description: A timed meeting agenda focused on preparation, decisions and accountable outcomes.

sections.name: Meeting Details and Preparation
sections.description: Purpose, attendees, timing, access and pre-reading.

sections.name: Timed Agenda
sections.description: Ordered topics, presenters, timing and desired decisions.

sections.name: Expected Outcomes
sections.description: Decisions, actions and link to later minutes.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The agenda must serve a clear purpose.
Participants and timing are required for use.
A meeting agenda requires ordered topics.

recommendation_reason: Use this before a meeting to focus preparation and decisions.

name: Action Register
plain_description: A controlled register of actions, owners, due dates, evidence and closure history.

sections.name: Action Register
sections.description: Action ID, source, wording, owner, due date, priority and status.

sections.name: Evidence and Closure
sections.description: Progress evidence, closure confirmation and revision history.

fields.name: actions
fields.label: Actions, owners, due dates and status

missing_detail_rules.reason: Actions need a source context.
The register requires confirmed action records.

recommendation_reason: Use this to track accountable actions without marking work complete without evidence.

name: Decision Log
plain_description: A traceable record of decisions, options, confirmed rationale and review triggers.

sections.name: Decision Records
sections.description: ID, date, context, decision-maker, decision and status.

sections.name: Options and Rationale
sections.description: Options considered, confirmed rationale and consequences.

fields.name: decision_records
fields.label: Decisions, makers, dates, options and rationale

missing_detail_rules.reason: Decisions need a defined context.
The log requires confirmed decision records.

recommendation_reason: Use this to preserve why decisions were made without manufacturing rejected options or rationale.

name: Handover Document
plain_description: A practical transfer of responsibilities, active work, routines, risks, contacts and unresolved decisions.

sections.name: Handover Scope and Ownership
sections.description: Outgoing owner, incoming owner, responsibilities and status.

sections.name: Active Work and Routines
sections.description: Active work, deadlines, routines, systems and access routes.

sections.name: Risks and Open Decisions
sections.description: Known risks, missing knowledge and unresolved decisions.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The transfer parties must be clear.
The responsibilities being transferred must be defined.
Active risks and open decisions must not be hidden.

recommendation_reason: Use this to transfer operational knowledge without storing passwords or secrets.

name: Change Request
plain_description: A controlled request describing a proposed change, its impacts, approval state and implementation plan.

sections.name: Request and Proposed Change
sections.description: Requester, baseline, change and reason.

sections.name: Impact Assessment
sections.description: Cost, time, quality, risk and dependency impacts.

sections.name: Approval and Implementation
sections.description: Requested, approved and implemented states, rollout and rollback.

fields.name: impact_assessment
fields.label: Cost, time, quality and risk impacts

missing_detail_rules.reason: The request owner must be known.
The baseline and proposed change must be explicit.
A change cannot be evaluated without its known impacts.

recommendation_reason: Use this to assess and approve change without confusing requested, approved and implemented states.

name: Leave Request and Availability Form
plain_description: A privacy-conscious request recording leave dates or availability without implying approval.

sections.name: Employee Request
sections.description: Employee, workplace, request type, dates and status.

sections.name: Evidence and Handover
sections.description: Minimum necessary reason, supplied evidence and handover.

sections.name: Approval Route
sections.description: Approver, decision status and response record.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The requesting employee must be identified.
The requested leave or availability must be specific.
The form must show where the request goes.

recommendation_reason: Use this to make a leave or availability request while keeping approval separate.

name: Performance Improvement Plan
plain_description: A neutral, evidence-based improvement plan with support, measures, review dates and response process.

sections.name: Expectations and Evidence
sections.description: Role expectations and specific confirmed performance evidence.

sections.name: Required Improvement and Support
sections.description: Required change, measures, support and learning actions.

sections.name: Review and Response Process
sections.description: Review dates, supplied consequences and response process.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The plan must relate to a defined role.
A fair plan requires specific evidence and expectations.
Required improvement and employer support must be explicit.

recommendation_reason: Use this for a procedurally fair improvement process without inventing misconduct or prior warnings.

name: Training Plan and Skills Matrix
plain_description: An evidence-based skills matrix and training plan that distinguishes not assessed from not competent.

sections.name: Roles and Required Competencies
sections.description: Roles, competencies and evidence standards.

sections.name: Current Capability and Gaps
sections.description: Evidence-backed current capability and gaps.

sections.name: Training and Reassessment Plan
sections.description: Actions, owners, dates and reassessment method.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The matrix requires defined competencies.
Capability status must be evidence based.
A training plan requires accountable actions.

recommendation_reason: Use this to plan development without inferring qualifications or treating unassessed skills as failures.

name: Incident / Near-Miss Report
plain_description: A factual incident record separating observations, immediate controls, analysis and corrective actions.

sections.name: Report Details
sections.description: Reporter, date, time, location and people involved.

sections.name: Factual Sequence and Impact
sections.description: Observed sequence, injury, damage, witnesses and evidence.

sections.name: Controls, Notifications and Actions
sections.description: Immediate controls, notifications, analysis and corrective actions.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The report needs accountable time and place details.
The event sequence must be recorded factually.
Immediate controls and notifications are essential records.

recommendation_reason: Use this to preserve incident facts and actions without deciding legal notification status.

name: Asset Register and Maintenance Log
plain_description: A traceable asset register with condition, service schedule and evidenced maintenance history.

sections.name: Asset Register
sections.description: Asset identity, location, owner, serial, acquisition and warranty.

sections.name: Condition and Criticality
sections.description: Confirmed condition, criticality and service requirements.

sections.name: Maintenance History
sections.description: Evidenced completed work, cost and next due date.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The register needs a defined scope.
Assets must have confirmed identifiers and locations.
Maintenance status must trace to supplied records.

recommendation_reason: Use this to track assets and service evidence without inventing maintenance completion or compliance.

name: Stocktake / Inventory Count
plain_description: A controlled stock count preserving actual quantities, variances, recounts and approval.

sections.name: Count Controls
sections.description: Site, count date, counter and blind-count settings.

sections.name: Inventory Count
sections.description: Item, unit, expected quantity, actual quantity, variance and condition.

sections.name: Recount and Adjustment Review
sections.description: Recount history and adjustment approval.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The count requires site, date and accountability.
Actual item counts are the core record.
Variances and adjustments require review history.

recommendation_reason: Use this to record stock counts without silently posting inventory adjustments.

name: Business Case
plain_description: A decision-ready business case comparing options, evidence, costs, benefits, risks and assumptions.

sections.name: Problem, Opportunity and Strategic Fit
sections.description: Decision context, need, objectives and stakeholders.

sections.name: Options and Evidence
sections.description: Options, quantified evidence, costs and benefits.

sections.name: Risks and Recommendation
sections.description: Risks, assumptions, timeline, recommendation and decision.

fields.name: decision_need
fields.label: Problem or opportunity and decision required

missing_detail_rules.reason: The case must define the decision.
A business case must compare evidence-backed options.
Material uncertainty must be visible.

recommendation_reason: Use this when a decision-maker needs an evidence-led recommendation and alternatives.

name: Customer Feedback Summary
plain_description: A bounded synthesis of supplied customer feedback, themes, evidence, severity and recommended actions.

sections.name: Source Coverage and Method
sections.description: Source set, period, audience, privacy limits and analysis method.

sections.name: Themes and Evidence
sections.description: Themes, disclosed sentiment method, excerpts, frequency and severity.

sections.name: Findings and Recommended Actions
sections.description: Bounded conclusions, limitations and prioritised actions.

missing_detail_rules.reason: Findings must be bounded to a source set and period.
The summary must serve a defined audience and purpose.
Themes cannot be generated without supplied feedback.

recommendation_reason: Use this to turn supplied feedback into evidence-led themes without inventing respondents.

name: Competitor Comparison
plain_description: A dated, cited comparison that distinguishes unknown information from absent features.

sections.name: Decision Scope and Sources
sections.description: Decision purpose, competitors, date, criteria and permitted sources.

sections.name: Evidence Comparison
sections.description: Cited competitor evidence by criterion with unknowns explicit.
vital: Current source for each factual claim

sections.name: Interpretation and Recommendation
sections.description: Trade-offs, limitations and separate recommendation.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The comparison needs a defined decision and date.
Competitors and criteria determine the analysis.
Claims require current permitted evidence.

recommendation_reason: Use this for a source-backed market comparison without treating unknown information as absent.

name: Timesheet
plain_description: An auditable record of actual hours, breaks, categories, approvals and corrections.

sections.name: Worker and Pay Period
sections.description: Business, worker, engagement, project, pay period and timezone.

sections.name: Actual Time Entries
sections.description: Dates, actual starts and ends, breaks and confirmed hour categories.

sections.name: Totals, Approval and Corrections
sections.description: Deterministic totals, submission, approval and revision history.

fields.name: worker_period
fields.label: Business, worker, pay period and timezone

fields.name: time_entries
fields.label: Actual dated time and break entries

missing_detail_rules.reason: Actual hours require a worker, period and timezone.
A timesheet requires actual time records.
The record needs a submission and approval route.

recommendation_reason: Use this to record actual time, not a planned roster or unsupported wage entitlement.

name: Staff Roster
plain_description: A forward-looking staff schedule with availability, coverage, conflicts and publication history.

sections.name: Roster Basis and Constraints
sections.description: Site, period, timezone, operating hours, roles and confirmed constraints.

sections.name: Scheduled Shifts
sections.description: Employees or placeholders, roles, dates, locations, shifts and breaks.

sections.name: Coverage and Change Control
sections.description: Coverage, conflicts, publication state and amendment history.

fields.name: roster_basis
fields.label: Business, site, roster period and timezone

fields.name: staff_constraints
fields.label: Staff, roles, availability and coverage requirements

fields.name: scheduled_shifts
fields.label: Dated shifts, roles, locations and breaks

missing_detail_rules.reason: A roster requires a site, period and timezone.
Coverage cannot be planned without roles and availability.
The roster requires explicit planned shifts.

recommendation_reason: Use this to plan future work while keeping availability, qualifications and approval facts explicit.

name: Moving House Checklist
plain_description: A step-by-step checklist covering everything to sort before, during and after a house move.

sections.name: Action Items
sections.description: Concrete steps with suggested timing.
vital: Whether it's a rental or owned property
improver: Utility providers to transfer (power, gas, internet, water)
Address-update list (bank, licence, electoral roll, Medicare)

recommendation_reason: A moving checklist turns a stressful, easy-to-miss-a-step process into a clear timeline.

name: New Tenancy / Lease Checklist
plain_description: A checklist for signing a new lease and settling into a rental — condition report, bond, and utility set-up.

sections.name: Action Items
sections.description: Concrete steps with suggested timing.
vital: Whether a condition report has been done
improver: Real estate agent or landlord contact details

recommendation_reason: A tenancy checklist protects the bond and makes sure nothing gets missed at move-in.

name: Complaint Letter
plain_description: A clear, firm complaint letter to a business, landlord or service provider that states the issue and what you want done about it.

sections.name: The Issue
sections.description: What happened, when, and why it's a problem — specific facts, not general frustration.
improver: Prior contact already made about this

sections.name: Impact
sections.description: The real effect the issue has had — cost, inconvenience, or harm.

sections.name: Requested Resolution
sections.description: Exactly what outcome would resolve this — a refund, repair, replacement, or apology.
improver: A reasonable deadline to respond by
Next step if not resolved (e.g. ombudsman, regulator)

sections.name: Closing
sections.description: A firm, professional close with contact details.

missing_detail_rules.reason: The letter needs to be addressed to the right person or business.
A complaint without a stated outcome is easy to ignore.

recommendation_reason: A written complaint that states facts and a clear ask gets taken seriously and creates a paper trail.

name: Insurance Claim Letter
plain_description: A letter to an insurer setting out an incident, the policy it falls under, and the claim being made.

sections.name: Policy Details
sections.description: The policy this claim is made under.

sections.name: Incident Details
sections.description: What happened, when, and where — the factual basis of the claim.

sections.name: Loss or Damage
sections.description: What was lost, damaged, or affected, and its value where known.

sections.name: Requested Action
sections.description: What the claim is asking the insurer to do.
improver: Preferred next step (assessor visit, repair quote, payout)

fields.name: incident_summary
fields.label: What happened
fields.placeholder: a burst pipe damaged the kitchen ceiling

missing_detail_rules.reason: The insurer can't process a claim without it.
The whole claim depends on a clear factual account of what happened.

recommendation_reason: A structured claim letter with the right facts up front moves faster through an insurer's process.

name: Client Engagement Letter
plain_description: A letter confirming the scope, fees and terms of work agreed with a new client before work begins.

sections.name: Scope of Engagement
sections.description: Exactly what work is being done, and what is explicitly out of scope.
improver: What is explicitly out of scope

sections.name: Fees and Payment
sections.description: What is being charged, how, and when payment is due.

sections.name: Responsibilities
sections.description: What each side is responsible for providing or doing.

sections.name: Terms and Sign-off
sections.description: How the engagement can end, and the acceptance/sign-off mechanism.

fields.name: scope_summary
fields.label: What the work is
fields.placeholder: a brand refresh and new website

missing_detail_rules.reason: The letter needs to name who the engagement is with.
Every other section — fees, responsibilities — depends on knowing what the work actually is.

recommendation_reason: A written engagement letter avoids scope disputes later by confirming what was agreed, in writing, before work starts.

name: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
plain_description: A one-way or mutual confidentiality agreement for sharing sensitive information with another party.

sections.name: Parties
sections.description: Who is disclosing, who is receiving, and whether the obligation runs one way or both ways.

sections.name: Confidential Information
sections.description: What counts as confidential under this agreement, and what is explicitly excluded.
vital: The purpose the information is being shared for
improver: What is explicitly excluded (e.g. publicly available information)

sections.name: Obligations
sections.description: What the receiving party must and must not do with the information.
improver: Who else it can be shared with

sections.name: Term and General Provisions
sections.description: How long the agreement and confidentiality obligations last, and governing law.

fields.name: receiving_party
fields.label: Receiving party
fields.placeholder: the other business or person's name

missing_detail_rules.reason: An NDA is meaningless without naming who is bound by it.
An NDA is meaningless without naming who is bound by it.

recommendation_reason: An NDA sets clear expectations before sharing sensitive business information with someone outside the business.

name: Research Report
plain_description: A structured report presenting research findings on any topic — background, method, findings, and conclusions.

sections.name: Introduction
sections.description: The research topic, question, and why it matters — stated specifically, not generically.
improver: Scope and any limits on scope

sections.name: Method / Approach
sections.description: How the research was carried out — sources used, or the approach taken.

sections.name: Findings
sections.description: What the research actually found, grounded in the sources and information provided — never fabricated.

sections.name: Analysis / Discussion
sections.description: What the findings mean, and how they relate to the original question.
improver: Comparison to existing knowledge or prior work

sections.name: Conclusion and Recommendations
sections.description: A clear conclusion answering the original question, with any recommendations.
improver: Suggested next steps or further research

fields.name: research_topic
fields.label: Research topic or question
fields.placeholder: the impact of remote work on regional housing demand

missing_detail_rules.reason: Every section of the report depends on knowing exactly what is being researched.

recommendation_reason: A structured research report keeps findings organised and grounded in real sources, on whatever topic you need to research.
